snippet.title: Everyday Devil
snippet.description:
Game Link: https://alleesaur.itch.io/everyday-devil\
Release Date: Dec 5, 2025

A short, linear story game revolving around fragments of a random demon guy's life.

The scattered pieces of memory are short, and somewhat disjointed... it's mostly a lot of walking and talking. The style of it may be a little different between each vignette, depending on Cecil's feelings at the time.

It's a strange world, full of darkness. But it's just everyday life for him. I hope you understand.

~~~

Art, Coding, Music, Characters: alleesaur

Writing, Direction: klausthecloset

Special Design Thanks: sillydogjoe, mbox316, chdata
